whatItDoes: Provides one synthetic export for end-to-end catalog validation.
The fixture is test data and is not a real public catalog entry.

situations.when: The catalog CLI needs a complete repository root

whatItAdds: A deterministic valid input for automated checks.

questions.question: Is this a public catalog entry?
answer: No. It exists only under the test fixture directory.

workingIf: The CLI reports one valid featured entry.
setupNotes: No setup is needed outside the test suite.
